column1: dog|n.|狗|My dog waits for me at the door every day.|我的狗每天都在門口等我。|The dog barked at the stranger.|那隻狗對陌生人吠叫。
cat|n.|貓|The cat is sleeping on the sofa.|貓正睡在沙發上。|Our cat likes to chase birds in the garden.|我們的貓喜歡在花園裡追鳥。
horse|n.|馬|She learned to ride a horse when she was ten.|她十歲時學會了騎馬。|The horse ran across the field.|那匹馬跑過了田野。
cow|n.|母牛，乳牛|The farmer milks the cows every morning.|農夫每天早上擠牛奶。|A cow was eating grass by the river.|一頭母牛在河邊吃草。
pig|n.|豬|The farm has two pigs and a few chickens.|這個農場有兩頭豬和幾隻雞。|The little pig rolled in the mud.|小豬在泥巴裡打滾。
sheep|n.|綿羊|A flock of sheep was walking down the road.|一群綿羊正沿著路走。|Wool comes from sheep.|羊毛來自綿羊。
goat|n.|山羊|The goat climbed up the rock.|山羊爬上了岩石。|We drank goat milk at the farm.|我們在農場喝了羊奶。
chicken|n.|雞；雞肉|The chicken laid an egg this morning.|那隻雞今天早上下了一顆蛋。|I'd like fried chicken with rice.|我想要炸雞配白飯。
duck|n.|鴨子；鴨肉|The ducks are swimming in the pond.|鴨子們正在池塘裡游泳。|Roast duck is a famous dish in Beijing.|烤鴨是北京的名菜。
rabbit|n.|兔子|The rabbit eats carrots and grass.|兔子吃紅蘿蔔和草。|She keeps a white rabbit as a pet.|她養了一隻白兔當寵物。
monkey|n.|猴子|The monkey climbed up the tree quickly.|猴子很快就爬上了樹。|Monkeys are very clever animals.|猴子是非常聰明的動物。
lion|n.|獅子|The lion is called the king of the jungle.|獅子被稱為叢林之王。|We saw a lion sleeping at the zoo.|我們在動物園看到一隻正在睡覺的獅子。
tiger|n.|老虎|A tiger has black stripes on its body.|老虎身上有黑色的條紋。|Tigers live in forests and grasslands.|老虎生活在森林和草原。
wolf|n.|狼|The wolf howled at the moon.|狼對著月亮嚎叫。|Wolves usually live and hunt in groups.|狼通常成群生活與狩獵。
fox|n.|狐狸|A red fox ran across the road.|一隻紅狐狸跑過馬路。|The fox is known for being clever.|狐狸以聰明聞名。
deer|n.|鹿|We saw a deer in the forest.|我們在森林裡看到一隻鹿。|Deer have long, thin legs.|鹿有細長的腿。
giraffe|n.|長頸鹿|The giraffe reached for the leaves with its long neck.|長頸鹿伸長脖子去吃樹葉。|A giraffe is the tallest animal in the world.|長頸鹿是世界上最高的動物。
zebra|n.|斑馬|A zebra has black and white stripes.|斑馬身上有黑白相間的條紋。|The children laughed when the zebra ran by.|斑馬跑過時，孩子們笑了起來。
kangaroo|n.|袋鼠|The kangaroo carries its baby in a pouch.|袋鼠把寶寶放在育兒袋裡。|Kangaroos live in Australia.|袋鼠生活在澳洲。
panda|n.|貓熊，熊貓|The giant panda eats bamboo all day.|大貓熊整天都在吃竹子。|We waited in line to see the pandas at the zoo.|我們排隊去動物園看貓熊。
whale|n.|鯨魚|A blue whale is the biggest animal on Earth.|藍鯨是地球上最大的動物。|We went on a boat to watch whales.|我們搭船去賞鯨。
dolphin|n.|海豚|The dolphin jumped out of the water.|海豚跳出了水面。|Dolphins are friendly and intelligent.|海豚友善又聰明。
shark|n.|鯊魚|A shark can smell blood from far away.|鯊魚可以從很遠的地方聞到血的味道。|The diver saw a shark near the reef.|潛水員在珊瑚礁附近看到一隻鯊魚。
fish|n.|魚|We caught three fish in the river.|我們在河裡釣到三條魚。|She keeps a few colorful fish in a tank.|她在魚缸裡養了幾隻色彩繽紛的魚。
bird|n.|鳥|A little bird was singing in the tree.|一隻小鳥正在樹上唱歌。|Most birds can fly.|大多數鳥類會飛。
eagle|n.|老鷹|The eagle flew high above the mountains.|老鷹在山上高高地飛翔。|An eagle has very sharp eyes.|老鷹的視力非常敏銳。
owl|n.|貓頭鷹|The owl hunts at night.|貓頭鷹在夜間獵食。|We heard an owl outside our window.|我們聽到窗外有貓頭鷹的叫聲。
parrot|n.|鸚鵡|The parrot can repeat what you say.|這隻鸚鵡會學你說的話。|He has a colorful parrot at home.|他家裡養了一隻色彩鮮豔的鸚鵡。
snake|n.|蛇|Be careful, there might be a snake in the grass.|小心，草叢裡可能有蛇。|The snake slid under the rock.|蛇滑進了岩石底下。
frog|n.|青蛙|A frog jumped into the pond.|一隻青蛙跳進了池塘。|We heard frogs singing after the rain.|雨後我們聽到青蛙在鳴叫。
turtle|n.|烏龜，海龜|The turtle moves very slowly.|烏龜行動非常緩慢。|Sea turtles lay their eggs on the beach.|海龜在海灘上產卵。
crocodile|n.|鱷魚|A crocodile was lying by the river.|一隻鱷魚躺在河邊。|Crocodiles have strong jaws and sharp teeth.|鱷魚有強壯的下巴和鋒利的牙齒。
spider|n.|蜘蛛|There is a spider on the wall.|牆上有一隻蜘蛛。|The spider made a web in the corner.|蜘蛛在角落結了一張網。
ant|n.|螞蟻|Ants carry food back to their nest.|螞蟻把食物搬回牠們的巢。|There are ants on the kitchen floor.|廚房地板上有螞蟻。
bee|n.|蜜蜂|A bee flew into the room.|一隻蜜蜂飛進了房間。|Bees make honey from flowers.|蜜蜂用花蜜釀蜂蜜。
butterfly|n.|蝴蝶|A butterfly landed on the flower.|一隻蝴蝶停在花上。|The garden is full of colorful butterflies.|花園裡到處是色彩繽紛的蝴蝶。
squirrel|n.|松鼠|The squirrel ran up the tree with a nut.|松鼠叼著堅果跑上了樹。|Squirrels store food for the winter.|松鼠會儲存食物過冬。
apple|n.|蘋果|An apple a day keeps the doctor away.|一天一蘋果，醫生遠離我。|She cut the apple into four pieces.|她把蘋果切成四塊。
banana|n.|香蕉|I eat a banana for breakfast every day.|我每天早餐吃一根香蕉。|Monkeys love bananas.|猴子愛吃香蕉。
orange|n.|柳橙；橘色|I drink a glass of orange juice every morning.|我每天早上喝一杯柳橙汁。|The sky turned orange at sunset.|日落時天空變成了橘色。
lime|n.|萊姆，青檸|Squeeze some lime juice onto the fish.|在魚上擠一些萊姆汁。|The drink comes with a slice of lime.|這杯飲料附有一片萊姆。
grape|n.|葡萄|These grapes are sweet and juicy.|這些葡萄又甜又多汁。|Wine is made from grapes.|葡萄酒是用葡萄釀成的。
strawberry|n.|草莓|I'd like a strawberry cake for my birthday.|我生日想要一個草莓蛋糕。|The strawberries are in season in winter.|草莓在冬天是當季水果。
blueberry|n.|藍莓|She puts blueberries in her yogurt.|她在優格裡加藍莓。|My son loves blueberry muffins.|我兒子很愛藍莓瑪芬。
cherry|n.|櫻桃|A cherry sat on top of the cake.|蛋糕上放著一顆櫻桃。|Cherry trees bloom in spring.|櫻桃樹在春天開花。
peach|n.|桃子|The peach was soft and juicy.|這顆桃子又軟又多汁。|Peaches are sweet in summer.|桃子在夏天特別甜。
pear|n.|梨子|He peeled a pear and shared it with me.|他削了一顆梨子與我分享。|This pear tastes sweet and fresh.|這顆梨子吃起來又甜又清脆。
plum|n.|李子|She made jam from fresh plums.|她用新鮮的李子做果醬。|The plum tree in our garden is full of fruit.|我們花園裡的李子樹結滿了果實。
apricot|n.|杏桃|Dried apricots are a healthy snack.|杏桃乾是健康的零食。|The apricot tree blooms in early spring.|杏樹在早春開花。
mango|n.|芒果|Mango is my favorite summer fruit.|芒果是我最愛的夏季水果。|We had mango shaved ice for dessert.|我們吃了芒果冰當甜點。
pineapple|n.|鳳梨|Pineapple cake is a popular gift from Taiwan.|鳳梨酥是受歡迎的台灣伴手禮。|He cut the pineapple into small pieces.|他把鳳梨切成小塊。
watermelon|n.|西瓜|We shared a cold watermelon on a hot day.|大熱天我們分食了一顆冰涼的西瓜。|Watermelon is full of water.|西瓜含有大量水分。
melon|n.|瓜；哈密瓜|She ordered a plate of fresh melon.|她點了一盤新鮮的哈密瓜。|The melon is ripe and very sweet.|這顆瓜熟了，而且非常甜。
papaya|n.|木瓜|Papaya milk is a popular drink in Taiwan.|木瓜牛奶在台灣是很受歡迎的飲料。|The papaya is orange inside.|木瓜裡面是橘色的。
guava|n.|芭樂，番石榴|Guava is crunchy and rich in vitamin C.|芭樂清脆，而且富含維他命 C。|He bought a bag of guavas at the market.|他在市場買了一袋芭樂。
kiwi|n.|奇異果|A kiwi is green inside and has small black seeds.|奇異果裡面是綠色的，還有小小的黑籽。|I eat a kiwi after dinner every night.|我每天晚餐後都吃一顆奇異果。
coconut|n.|椰子|We drank fresh coconut water on the beach.|我們在海灘上喝新鮮的椰子水。|Coconut trees grow along the coast.|椰子樹生長在海岸邊。
pomegranate|n.|石榴|The pomegranate is full of red seeds.|石榴裡面滿是紅色的籽。|She drank a glass of pomegranate juice.|她喝了一杯石榴汁。
fig|n.|無花果|Figs are sweet and soft inside.|無花果裡面又甜又軟。|He ate dried figs as a snack.|他吃無花果乾當點心。
avocado|n.|酪梨，牛油果|She spread avocado on her toast.|她在吐司上抹了酪梨。|An avocado is ripe when it feels a little soft.|酪梨摸起來有點軟時就是熟了。
grapefruit|n.|葡萄柚|Grapefruit juice tastes a little bitter.|葡萄柚汁嚐起來有點苦。|He cut the grapefruit in half.|他把葡萄柚切成兩半。
tangerine|n.|橘子，柑橘|The tangerine is easy to peel.|橘子很容易剝皮。|We eat tangerines during Chinese New Year.|我們在農曆新年時吃橘子。
raspberry|n.|覆盆子|The cake was topped with fresh raspberries.|蛋糕上放了新鮮的覆盆子。|Raspberry jam is delicious on toast.|覆盆子果醬塗在吐司上很好吃。
lychee|n.|荔枝|Lychee has a thin red skin and sweet white flesh.|荔枝有薄薄的紅皮和甜甜的白色果肉。|She bought a basket of lychees in summer.|她夏天買了一籃荔枝。
persimmon|n.|柿子|Persimmons turn orange in autumn.|柿子在秋天會變成橘色。|Dried persimmon is a popular snack.|柿餅是受歡迎的零食。
durian|n.|榴槤|Durian has a very strong smell.|榴槤有非常濃烈的味道。|Some people love durian, but others can't stand it.|有些人愛吃榴槤，有些人卻受不了。
potato|n.|馬鈴薯|I'd like mashed potato with my steak.|我的牛排想配馬鈴薯泥。|She peeled the potatoes for dinner.|她為晚餐削了馬鈴薯皮。
tomato|n.|番茄|Slice a tomato and put it in the sandwich.|把番茄切片放進三明治裡。|Tomato soup is warm and comforting.|番茄湯溫暖又令人安心。
onion|n.|洋蔥|Chopping onions makes me cry.|切洋蔥讓我流眼淚。|Fry the onion until it turns golden.|把洋蔥炒到金黃色。
garlic|n.|大蒜|Add two cloves of garlic to the pan.|在鍋裡加兩瓣大蒜。|The kitchen smelled of fresh garlic.|廚房聞起來有新鮮大蒜的味道。
cabbage|n.|高麗菜|Cabbage is cheap and good for you.|高麗菜便宜又對身體好。|She cut the cabbage into thin strips.|她把高麗菜切成細絲。
lettuce|n.|萵苣，生菜|The burger comes with lettuce and tomato.|這個漢堡附有生菜和番茄。|Wash the lettuce before making a salad.|做沙拉前要先把生菜洗乾淨。
spinach|n.|菠菜|Spinach is rich in iron.|菠菜富含鐵質。|Stir-fry the spinach with garlic.|用大蒜炒菠菜。
broccoli|n.|花椰菜，綠花椰|Children often don't like broccoli.|小孩常常不愛吃綠花椰菜。|Steam the broccoli for three minutes.|把綠花椰菜蒸三分鐘。
cauliflower|n.|白花椰菜|Cauliflower is white and has a mild taste.|白花椰菜是白色的，味道溫和。|She roasted a cauliflower in the oven.|她用烤箱烤了一顆白花椰菜。
cucumber|n.|小黃瓜，黃瓜|Add some cucumber to the salad.|在沙拉裡加一些小黃瓜。|A cold cucumber is refreshing in summer.|冰涼的小黃瓜在夏天吃起來很清爽。
pumpkin|n.|南瓜|We carved a pumpkin for Halloween.|我們為萬聖節雕了一顆南瓜。|Pumpkin soup is perfect for a cold day.|南瓜湯最適合寒冷的日子。
corn|n.|玉米|We grilled corn at the barbecue.|我們在烤肉時烤了玉米。|The farmer grows corn in this field.|農夫在這片田裡種玉米。
pea|n.|豌豆|She added peas to the fried rice.|她在炒飯裡加了豌豆。|A pea is small and round.|豌豆小小圓圓的。
bean|n.|豆子|Soy milk is made from soybeans.|豆漿是用黃豆做成的。|She cooked a pot of red bean soup.|她煮了一鍋紅豆湯。
mushroom|n.|蘑菇，香菇|I like mushroom soup.|我喜歡蘑菇湯。|Don't eat wild mushrooms unless you are sure they are safe.|除非確定安全，否則不要吃野生蘑菇。
celery|n.|芹菜|Celery is low in calories.|芹菜的熱量很低。|She put some celery in the soup.|她在湯裡放了一些芹菜。
eggplant|n.|茄子|Grilled eggplant is delicious with garlic.|烤茄子配大蒜很好吃。|My mom cooks braised eggplant with pork.|我媽媽會做茄子燒肉。
radish|n.|白蘿蔔，櫻桃蘿蔔|Radish soup is a classic winter dish.|蘿蔔湯是冬天的經典菜餚。|She sliced a radish for the salad.|她把一顆蘿蔔切片放進沙拉。
turnip|n.|蕪菁，大頭菜|Turnip is a root vegetable.|蕪菁是一種根莖類蔬菜。|The farmer pulled a turnip from the ground.|農夫從地裡拔出一顆蕪菁。
zucchini|n.|櫛瓜|She grilled slices of zucchini.|她烤了幾片櫛瓜。|Zucchini is soft when it is cooked.|櫛瓜煮熟後很軟。
asparagus|n.|蘆筍|Grilled asparagus goes well with fish.|烤蘆筍和魚很搭。|She bought a bunch of fresh asparagus.|她買了一把新鮮蘆筍。
beet|n.|甜菜根|Beet juice is deep red.|甜菜根汁是深紅色的。|He added sliced beets to the salad.|他在沙拉裡加了甜菜根片。
leek|n.|韭蔥|Leek is similar to a large green onion.|韭蔥像是一種大型的青蔥。|The soup is made with potatoes and leeks.|這道湯是用馬鈴薯和韭蔥煮的。
sweet-potato|n.|地瓜，甘薯|Roasted sweet potato is a popular winter snack.|烤地瓜是冬天很受歡迎的點心。|My grandmother grows sweet potatoes on her farm.|我奶奶在農場種地瓜。
seaweed|n.|海藻，海苔|Rice rolls are wrapped in seaweed.|飯捲是用海苔包起來的。|Seaweed soup is good for your health.|海帶湯對健康有益。
tofu|n.|豆腐|Stinky tofu is a famous Taiwanese snack.|臭豆腐是著名的台灣小吃。|She cooked tofu with vegetables.|她用蔬菜煮了豆腐。
sprout|n.|芽，豆芽|Bean sprouts are crunchy and fresh.|豆芽菜清脆又新鮮。|A small green sprout came out of the soil.|一株小綠芽從土裡冒了出來。
herb|n.|香草，藥草|She grows herbs like mint and basil on her balcony.|她在陽台種薄荷和羅勒等香草。|Fresh herbs make the soup taste better.|新鮮香草讓湯更好喝。
